_comment: STARTER FILE for importing an existing OpenAPI spec instead of hand-writing contracts. You name the spec and the operationIds you want; a converter reads this and emits full single-tool contracts, which then flow through the exact same gate as anything hand-written. NOTE: the converter itself is out of scope for this POC -- the schema accepts this kind so the lane exists, but nothing consumes it yet.
_comment_operations: Only these operationIds are imported. Importing a whole spec unreviewed is exactly what the gate exists to prevent.

defaults._comment: Applied to every imported operation unless an override says otherwise.

_comment_overrides: 'overrides' is keyed by operationId -- use it to add selection hints the spec cannot express, or to tighten governance on one operation. Note the comment lives out here: every key inside 'overrides' is treated as an operationId.

whenToUse: The user asks where an order is or whether it shipped.
whenNotToUse: No order ID is available -- search first.
